stripe_connections.comment: Almacena las credenciales de conexión a Stripe por holding
triggers: update_stripe_connections_updated_at · BEFORE UPDATE FOR EACH ROW → update_stripe_updated_at_column()
policies: Users can delete their holding's Stripe connections (DELETE, public)
Users can insert Stripe connections for their holdings (INSERT, public)
Users can update their holding's Stripe connections (UPDATE, public)
Users can view their holding's Stripe connections (SELECT, public)

policies_detail.name: Users can delete their holding's Stripe connections
policies_detail.using:
(holding_id IN ( SELECT user_holdings.holding_id
   FROM user_holdings
  WHERE (user_holdings.user_id = auth.uid())))

policies_detail.name: Users can insert Stripe connections for their holdings

   FROM user_holdings
  WHERE (user_holdings.user_id = auth.uid())))

stripe_product_mappings.comment: Tabla de mapeo N:N entre productos de Sapira y productos de Stripe

constraints.name: stripe_product_mappings_holding_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (holding_id) REFERENCES company_holdings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: stripe_product_mappings_sapira_product_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (sapira_product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

stripe_sync_jobs.comment: Tabla para trackear el progreso de jobs de sincronización de Stripe a Sapira

indexes.name: idx_stripe_sync_jobs_created_at
indexes.expr: CREATE INDEX idx_stripe_sync_jobs_created_at ON public.stripe_sync_jobs USING btree (created_at DESC)

triggers: trigger_update_stripe_sync_jobs_updated_at · BEFORE UPDATE FOR EACH ROW → update_stripe_sync_jobs_updated_at()
